rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Define a bounded Boolean circuit or truth-table family that can falsify one current lemma. Record symmetries, completeness claims, resource limits, and the reason this family targets the hypothesis.

deliverables.description: SEARCH_DOMAIN.json: exact Boolean family, symmetries, parameters, and completeness
SEARCH_BUDGET.md: case count, measured pilot rate, and hard resource caps

acceptance_criteria: Tie one search to a fixed lemma/version and state whether the family is complete modulo a proved symmetry reduction.
Compute the actual case count before dispatch; all Boolean truth tables number 2^(2^n), so increasing n is never an automatic next step.

Measure a short pilot only when an experiment is justified and set explicit CPU/RAM/runtime/case caps; prefer structured families and exact multiplicity formulas when exhaustive growth is prohibitive.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One bounded, candidate-specific search design is handed to the reusable engine; redesign only after a substantive target or family change.

assignments.target_statement: Compute integer Walsh spectra and exact influences for the chosen family. Verify Parseval, sign-valued inverse transforms, and independent edge counts before any entropy comparison.

deliverables.description: EXACT_WALSH_INTERFACE.py: reusable integer-spectrum and edge-influence implementation
ENGINE_CERTIFICATE.json: independent algebraic and edge-count checks

acceptance_criteria: Reuse an existing checked Walsh engine where possible; document any changed normalization instead of creating another independent copy by default.
For each accepted witness verify Parseval, the exact sign-valued inverse, and influence by independent edge counts.
Specify n, truth-table ordering, bit/sign convention, and integer denominator; floating entropy evaluation does not replace algebraic verification.

next_consumers.interface_use: exact rational spectral masses and influences

assignments.renewal_milestone: One tested exact interface becomes a shared baseline; new work is allocated to target-specific families, not repeated engine infrastructure.

assignments.target_statement: Turn a promising entropy inequality into rational interval bounds or an exact integer-product comparison. State the margin and stop precision refinement when its sign is rigorously determined.

deliverables.description: LOG_SIGN_CERTIFICATE.json: rational/interval bounds and strict violation margin
CERTIFIED_COMPARISON.md: exact inequality transformation and assumptions

acceptance_criteria: Start from exact algebraic masses; use outward logarithm enclosures or an exact integer-product comparison with a proved equivalence.
State the certified margin and stop precision refinement once its sign is determined.
Report unresolved zero/near-zero margins honestly and avoid using a grid or floating tolerance as an all-real-parameter certificate.

advisory_upstream.interface: exact rational spectral masses and influences

assignments.renewal_milestone: A rigorous sign certificate for one selected witness or a proof that the proposed equality requires a different symbolic treatment.

assignments.target_statement: Implement a second calculation for selected witnesses, using a different derivation or representation. Distinguish an independent implementation from rerunning the original script.

deliverables.description: REPRODUCTION_REPORT.json: independent spectra/influences and comparison result

acceptance_criteria: Implement from the original truth table/circuit with a different computational path, such as direct edge counts versus Fourier identities.
Do not count rerunning the original checker or importing its computed spectrum as independent reproduction.
Reconcile the exact rational quantities before comparing certified logarithmic margins, and record any remaining discrepancy at its first differing quantity.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One important witness or finite certificate is independently reproduced, with a clear limit on what that finite verification proves.

assignments.target_statement: Convert a recurring finite pattern into a parameterized construction and an analytic proof. If no bridge is found, archive the bounded search domain and do not present its absence of failures as a theorem.

deliverables.description: FINITE_PATTERN_TO_FAMILY.tex: explicit construction for every parameter
ASYMPTOTIC_PROOF.md: exact formulas, uniform remainder, and theorem scope

acceptance_criteria: Specify an actual Boolean family for every admissible parameter, rather than extrapolating a table of finite ratios.
Prove the coefficient/multiplicity formula and the relevant entropy/influence asymptotics analytically.
If a bridge is not obtained, preserve the exact searched domain and failed derivation without promoting absence of counterexamples to a theorem.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A parameterized theorem or counterfamily with a complete proof is the renewal criterion.
